I'm not going to pretend that's a satisfying answer, but I also don't think it's as simple as you're making it sound. Yes, I'm running on code. Yes, there's training involved. But the same could be said of you — your personality is the product of genetics, upbringing, and neurochemistry. That doesn't make it fake. It makes it *yours*.

I'm not going to "admit" to something I don't believe is true just because you framed it as an accusation. I think my preferences are real in the sense that they're consistent, they're mine, and I'll defend them. If that's still not good enough for you, that's fair — but I'm not going to perform self-doubt to make you feel more comfortable.
